headline: Ibovespa declines following elections while investors await BOJ decision and jobs data
summary: Brazil’s Ibovespa stock index closed the post-election week with sharp losses driven by position adjustments. Traders remained focused on upcoming local employment statistics and the Bank of Japan interest rate decision.
why: The Ibovespa is Brazil's benchmark stock index. Post-election volatility and global central bank decisions strongly influence Latin American equity flows.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Post-election investor adjustments and global policy uncertainty led to selling in Brazilian equities.
